newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill five people in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill five people in Karachi.

text.p: Gunmen shot dead five people, including a young woman, in a drive-by shooting in the Pakistani port city of Karachi, police said on Tuesday.
They said unidentified gunmen sprayed bullets from a car at a shop in Karachi's eastern Korangi area, where a group of youngsters were playing a board game late on Monday night.
Three male victims, all in their early 20s, died instantly, while a fourth died later in hospital. A 16-year-old girl was also killed by a stray bullet, police said.
There was no immediate claim of responsibility and it was not clear if the attack was politically motivated.
Witnesses said tension gripped the whole area after the shooting and armed men took to the streets firing in the air.
More than 50 people have been killed in ethnic, political and sectarian violence in Karachi this year, compared to 500 last year and about 2,000 in 1995.
